easyPrerequisites:
You control an untapped land.
Portent Tracker doesn't have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate a land by using the land granted to it by Tectonic Split by tapping it, adding nine mana of any color due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Portent Tracker by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Portent Tracker.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
